Question: Show me which chat channels has user_0164 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0164'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Show me which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 1 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Which posts received the most thumbsup reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'thumbsup'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Which categories have the most topics tagged memory?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'memory'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Show me which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 30 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: How many topics are tagged analytics?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'analytics'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged markdown?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'markdown'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Which chat channels has user_0389 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0389'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Show me which posts received the most cry reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'cry'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: What is the number of topics are tagged unread?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'unread'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Which categories have the most topics tagged realtime?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg

 WHERE tg.name = 'realtime'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Show me which posts received the most thumbsdown reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'thumbsdown'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Show the 5 most active chat channels in the last 7 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 5;

Question: How many topics are tagged spam?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'spam'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Which posts received the most clap reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'clap'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 1 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 180 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 90 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: How many topics are tagged docker?

    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'docker'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Show me which 20 users wrote the most posts in the last 14 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged moderation?

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count

  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'moderation'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 1 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Which categories have the most topics tagged images?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'images'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Show me which users started the most topics in Performance?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Performance'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'mobile'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 90 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Show me which posts received the most open_mouth reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'open_mouth'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Which categories have the most topics tagged jobs?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'jobs'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged email?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'email'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 7 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Which categories have the most topics tagged redis?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'redis'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Which posts received the most angry reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'angry'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: What is the number of topics are tagged postgres?

  FROM topics t

    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'postgres'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0138'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Show the 20 most active chat channels in the last 90 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Show me which chat channels has user_0161 posted in?

       COUNT(*) AS messages

  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id

Question: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 1 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Show me which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 7 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0138'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 180 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Show me which chat channels has user_0304 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0304'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: How many topics are tagged ember?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'ember'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Show me which chat channels has user_0252 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0252'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

 ORDER BY post_count DESC,

Question: Which users started the most topics in Documentation?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Documentation'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Show the 10 most active chat channels in the last 14 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 180 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Which chat channels has user_0323 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0323'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Which chat channels has user_0229 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0229'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 7 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Which categories have the most topics tagged webhooks?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'webhooks'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Show the 5 most active chat channels in the last 30 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Which categories have the most topics tagged reporting?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'reporting'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Which posts received the most open_mouth reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'open_mouth'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Show the 5 most active chat channels in the last 180 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 5;

  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u

    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Community'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username

Question: What is the number of visible topics are in the Documentation category?

  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Documentation'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
   AND t.visible = TRUE;

Question: What is the number of topics are tagged search?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'search'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Show the 10 most active chat channels in the last 90 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 10;

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'ai'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;
